Why Muhammad is a messenger

He did not know before

The Quran says he did not know the Book or faith before it, and never expected it.

Did he set out to be a prophet? The Quran says he had no expectation that the Book would be given to him, and that before it he did not know what the Book or faith were. It calls what came a spirit and a light. Bukhari reports his first answer to the command to read: I am not a reader. The book gives him no credit for it. It says the light was sent.

﴿وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَـٰنُ وَلَـٰكِن جَعَلْنَـٰهُ نُورًا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muḥammad], you guide to a straight path -

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:52

﴿وَمَا كُنتَ تَرْجُوٓا۟ أَن يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبُ إِلَّا رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ فَلَا تَكُونَنَّ ظَهِيرًا لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but [it is] a mercy from your Lord. So do not be an assistant to the disbelievers.

Quran · Al-Qasas 28:86

﴿نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰفِلِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

We relate to you, [O Muḥammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur’ān although you were, before it, among the unaware.

Quran · Yusuf 12:3

You might ask

QuestionDidn't he go on retreats to think?
AnswerBukhari says he withdrew to Hira. A seeker can still be surprised. The Quran's claim is narrow: he did not expect a Book.Quran · Al-Qasas 28:86
QuestionDoes this mean he had no faith before?
AnswerCommentators read it as the details of faith that revelation brought. The verse speaks of what he had not yet been taught, not of a man turned from God.Quran · Ash-Shura 42:52
QuestionHow reliable is that first report?
AnswerIt is an early report, passed on through Aisha, so treat it as a remembered account. The verses carry the argument.Quran · Al-Alaq 96:1

The book does not say he found it. It says it reached him, as mercy.
